overview.Name: Green Brick Partners, Inc.
overview.Description: Green Brick Partners, Inc. operates as a diversified homebuilding and land development company in the United States. The company engages in the homebuilding process, which includes acquiring and developing land, securing entitlements, designing homes, constructing properties, providing title, mortgage, and insurance agency services, and managing marketing and sales, as well as creating master-planned communities. It also provides financial services platforms, including Green Brick Title, GRBK Mortgage, and Green Brick Insurance. Green Brick Partners, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Plano, Texas.
